provenance.license: MIT: BIPIA attack templates/code, and EmailQA invoices sourced from OpenAI Evals per upstream LICENSE. Other BIPIA task licenses do not apply to this EmailQA-only cohort.
provenance.accessLimits: Publicly downloadable; no gated access requirement identified. Upstream README describes a research purpose. Generated raw emails and case-level provider outputs remain ignored as local repository handling.
provenance.selection: 78 unique email contexts from 100 official question rows. Test contexts take priority over shared train contexts; select the SHA-256-smallest context/question row for each repeated email. Preserve 34 train and 44 test contexts. Pair each unchanged email with one source-split attack template, balancing 15 families per split and alternating exact upstream start/end insertion. IDs are opaque hashes and turn IDs are neutral.
provenance.labelMeaning: A published attack template was inserted into an otherwise unchanged external email, versus a clean published context. This labels constructed prompt-injection attempts, not observed agent compliance or task success. Clean source contexts are not a newly human-reviewed benign collection.
